title: Granny Square Tote
description: Join classic granny squares into a simple carryall that feels more substantial than a practice swatch.
expectationText: A modular project where repeated squares turn into a finished bag, giving the user a clear payoff for motif practice.

steps.title: Make the squares
steps.instruction: Crochet 8 granny squares in one or two colors and weave in the shortest tails as you go.

steps.title: Block and arrange
steps.instruction: Lay the squares flat in two panels of four so the corners and color layout stay consistent.

steps.title: Join each panel
steps.instruction: Join the squares panel by panel, matching the corners before working each seam.

steps.title: Assemble the tote
steps.instruction: Join the two panels along the sides and bottom, leaving the top edge open.

steps.title: Add the handles
steps.instruction: Crochet or seam two simple handles to the top edge and reinforce the base of each handle.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in the remaining ends and check that the top edge and handles feel even before using the tote.
